ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a labeled schematic diagram of a plant cell. The cell as a whole is box-shaped/block-shaped, with a large central vacuole, green chloroplast-like organelles, and other cell structures inside; outside the cell edge there is a very thick, green, rigid external boundary, and a thinner boundary layer can also be seen on the inside. Reasoning: The question asks "what is the outermost layer". In a plant cell, what is located outside the cell membrane and forms the outermost rigid boundary is the cell wall. Therefore, the outermost layer is the cell wall.
